reason: The V2 synthetic Luna qualification demonstrated that the Windows filesystem and ACLs were writable while Codex 0.154.0 rejected writes as a read-only sandbox. Version-matched upstream source shows that --add-dir is mapped to additional_writable_roots and that the read-only rejection is emitted when the effective permission profile has no configured writable roots.

workspace_policy.workspace: persistent synthetic-workspace under qualification output directory

environment_failure_markers: writing is blocked by read-only sandbox

upstream_provenance.shared_cli_semantics: --add-dir is documented as additional directories writable alongside the primary workspace and is carried as SharedCliOptions.add_dir
upstream_provenance.exec_semantics: Codex exec copies add_dir into ConfigOverrides.additional_writable_roots
upstream_provenance.safety_semantics: read-only sandbox rejection is selected when the effective managed filesystem policy has no configured writable roots
